description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the Reviews screen, allowing users to rate their orders with star ratings, write feedback comments, and view existing reviews. It contains the ReviewsScreen widget, internal Review and ReviewTile classes, and manages review state internally.

classes.name: _Review
classes.description: Data class representing a review with properties for reviewer name, star rating, comment, date, and whether it is featured.

classes.name: _ReviewTile
classes.description: Stateless widget that displays individual review data in a card format including name, star rating, comment, and date.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the TextEditingController when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the reviews screen, including rating stars, feedback text input, submit button, and list of reviews.
